# expand

Replace tabs with spaces through MoonX.

## Usage

```sh
moonx cli/expand input.txt

moonx cli/expand -t 4 input.txt
```

Read files or stdin and expand tabs to the next tab stop. The default interval is eight columns.

## Common options

<!-- BEGIN GENERATED OPTIONS -->
<!-- Generated by tools/metadata from options.json. -->

| Option | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `-i`, `--initial` | Convert only leading blanks. |
| `-t VALUE`, `--tabs VALUE` | Select ascending tab stops. Default: `8`. |
| `--help` | Show help. |
| `--version` | Show the version. |
<!-- END GENERATED OPTIONS -->

## Notes

- C.UTF-8 uses Unicode display cells to locate tab stops. C uses byte-oriented column positions.

Build from source with the MoonBit 1.0 RC1 toolchain.

See the [compatibility guide](../../docs/compatibility.md) for the supported profile.
